title: PETR: Prompt Ensembling with Training-free Routing for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prompt learning efficiently adapts vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks, but gains on seen classes often come at the expense of generalization to unseen classes. To address this limitation, we propose prompt ensembling with training-free routing (PETR), whose key innovation is a carefully designed dual-prompt architecture: two complementary prompts are learned from different data and objectives to emphasize seen class discrimination and unseen-class generalization, respectively. During training, both prompts are fine-tuned using a shared frozen CLIP backbone, and statistical information is collected from the training set logits. At inference time, we determine the similarity of each test sample to seen data, and route the sample to the most appropriate prompt branch. translated_title: PETR：面向视觉-语言模型的无训练路由提示集成方法
translated_abstract: 提示学习能够高效地将视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配到下游任务，但在已见类别上获得的性能提升往往以牺牲对未见类别的泛化能力为代价。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了带无训练路由的提示集成方法（PETR），其关键创新是一种精心设计的双提示架构：从不同的数据和目标中学习两个互补的提示，分别强调已见类别的判别能力和未见类别的泛化能力。在训练过程中，两个提示均通过共享的冻结CLIP骨干网络进行微调，并从训练集的logits中收集统计信息。在推理时，我们计算每个测试样本与已见数据的相似度，并将样本路由到最合适的提示分支。据我们所知，这是首个基于统计相似性执行无训练自适应路由的提示微调框架。
tldr: PETR提出了一种双提示架构与基于统计相似性的无训练自适应路由方法，通过将测试样本动态路由到分别针对已见类别判别和未见类别泛化优化的提示分支，解决了提示学习中已见类别性能与未见类别泛化能力之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: PETR proposes a dual-prompt architecture with training-free adaptive routing based on statistical similarity, dynamically routing test samples to prompt branches optimized for seen-class discrimination or unseen-class generalization, thus addressing the trade-off between seen-class performance and unseen-class generalization in prompt learning.
